package.name: flyguard_ros2
package.description: ROS2 wrapper around the FlyGuard connectome-derived looming detector. looming_node runs a ~530-neuron real FAFB v783 subnetwork (LPLC2 + LC4 + LPi + DNp01) as a live LIF simulation and publishes /cmd_vel, with the real Giant Fiber (DNp01) escape pathway driving an emergency stop. vision_node is the real image-based front end (live MuJoCo rendering + Lucas-Kanade optical flow sampled at the real T4/T5 column population); demo_stimulus_node is a scripted stand-in that needs no rendering. vision_node and demo_stimulus_node additionally require the `mujoco` Python package (pip install flyguard[mujoco] -- not a rosdep package, resolved via the flyguard core install, not this package.xml).
